name: Bad Husbands
overview: Scripture clearly instructs husbands to love their wives sacrificially, modeling Christ's love for the church, which involves selflessness and deep commitment. They are also commanded to avoid bitterness, fostering a tender and respectful relationship within marriage. Furthermore, the holiness of marriage is emphasized, warning that unfaithfulness and immoral behavior will be judged by God, underscoring the sacredness and honor due in the marital union.
